purpose: A manually reasoned illustrative collection for figure and workflow review; no simulations or physical trials were run.
condition_assignment: Twenty conditions in condition_catalog.csv. Assign IDs in catalog order, cycling 40 times for calibration and 20 times for held-out. Each condition has calibration n=40 and held-out n=20. This assigns conditions only, never errors or costs.
command_id: Unique assumed command-program ID per pair; the same program is shared within the nominal/executed pair, not between different pairs.

S.label: straight with speed changes
S.features: forward tracking and acceleration; small heading changes

A.label: broad arc
A.features: sustained turning; lateral drift can persist

L.label: alternating bends
L.features: opposite turns can cancel endpoint drift; maximum deviation remains

T.label: stop then turn
T.features: transient braking and reacceleration; localized peak displacement

conditions_status: All numerical conditions are hypothetical design labels, not restored experiment settings. Noise scale describes assumed magnitude; no random noise is sampled by the data preparation scripts.
pairing: Identical initial state, map and command program within each nominal/executed pair; same frozen controller in every executed record.

measurement.geometry: maximum planar distance at time-aligned base positions across the paired common window
measurement.cost: paired cumulative positive illustrative cost, signed ratio (J_exec-J_nom)/J_nom

termination: This illustrative calibration collection assumes each command program runs for its preassigned common duration; no goal/success filtering and no selection by error magnitude. Actual early-stop records will require a predeclared paired-window rule before real-data substitution.
raw_logs: Not provided or fabricated; only run-level hypothetical aggregates are authored.
median: mean of the two central order statistics for even n
held_out_rule: Same predeclared condition mix, separate authored records after calibration freeze. No target held-out percentage and no calibration changes based on held-out results.
lidar: Not included; perception perturbations are separate from this execution calibration.
